rca_of_issue: New feature POST /rcg/assets/{asset_id}/restore was added to server.py at lines 1133-1149, but the diff also removed the standalone `@api.post('/rcg/assets/{asset_id}/sold')` line that used to sit immediately above `async def rcg_mark_sold`. As a result, rcg_mark_sold is now an undecorated coroutine and FastAPI no longer registers /rcg/assets/{id}/sold. Reproduction: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <RCG-JWT>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"notes":"x"}' <BASE>/api/rcg/assets/<PUBLISHED_ID>/sold` -> HTTP 404 {"detail":"Not Found"}. Mitigation: re-add the decorator (single line). No data-model change needed.
